data.content:
Here are the top 10 countries by number of sampling sites in the dataset:
- France — 4,689
- Netherlands — 3,608
- Germany — 1,212
- Slovakia — 453
- Sweden — 105
- Spain — 90
- Ireland — 79
- Italy — 73
- Serbia — 47
- Romania — 46

Reproduce with this Cypher query:
MATCH (l:Site)
WHERE l.country IS NOT NULL
WITH l.country AS Country, count(l) AS SiteCount
RETURN Country, SiteCount
ORDER BY SiteCount DESC, Country ASC
LIMIT 10

You can access the full Neo4j graph database (Docker image) here: https://zenodo.org/records/14616124
